FILE.ROLE: MQTT 3.1.1 codec: Remaining Length framing with incomplete/complete/invalid outcomes, per-packet decoders returning borrowed slices, and atomic packet encoders appending to a caller-owned byte_buf.

DATA.NAME: WIRE_MAX_STRING_LENGTH
DATA.ROLE: Maximum length of a length-prefixed UTF-8/binary field

DATA.NAME: enum wire_status
DATA.ROLE: Decode outcome of one framing or packet decode call

ENUM_VALUES.NAME: WIRE_INVALID
ENUM_VALUES.ROLE: Framing or control packet rule violated

DATA.NAME: enum wire_packet_type
DATA.ROLE: Control packet type constants for the 4-bit type field

DATA.NAME: struct wire_span
DATA.ROLE: Borrowed byte range inside a caller-owned packet buffer; no ownership

FIELDS.NAME: data
FIELDS.ROLE: Borrowed pointer into the decoded packet

DATA.NAME: struct wire_header
DATA.ROLE: Decoded fixed header: type, flags, body length, header bytes and total frame bytes

FIELDS.NAME: flags
FIELDS.ROLE: Low 4 bits of fixed header byte 1

FIELDS.NAME: remaining_length
FIELDS.ROLE: Bytes after the Remaining Length field

FIELDS.NAME: header_len
FIELDS.ROLE: Fixed header byte plus Remaining Length bytes (2..5)

DATA.NAME: struct wire_connect
DATA.ROLE: Decoded CONNECT fields as borrowed slices plus the policy inputs the caller needs

FIELDS.NAME: protocol_level
FIELDS.ROLE: Protocol Level byte from the variable header

FIELDS.NAME: keep_alive
FIELDS.ROLE: Keep Alive seconds, parsed and unused by this broker

FIELDS.NAME: has_will
FIELDS.ROLE: Will Flag bit; a set bit makes the connection out of scope

DATA.NAME: struct wire_subscribe
DATA.ROLE: Decoded SUBSCRIBE Packet Identifier plus the borrowed filter/QoS payload

FIELDS.NAME: packet_id
FIELDS.ROLE: Nonzero Packet Identifier to echo in SUBACK

DATA.NAME: struct wire_publish
DATA.ROLE: Decoded PUBLISH topic and payload slices with the DUP/QoS/RETAIN flag values

FIELDS.NAME: payload
FIELDS.ROLE: Borrowed payload bytes after topic and Packet Identifier

CALL_CONTRACTS.NAME: topic_utf8_validate
CALL_CONTRACTS.RETURN: 1 when the slice is well-formed UTF-8 without U+0000, otherwise 0; no failure under documented preconditions
CALL_CONTRACTS.FAILURE: never fails; a 0 result means the string is not usable as a UTF-8 encoded field

CALL_CONTRACTS.NAME: topic_name_validate
CALL_CONTRACTS.RETURN: 1 when the slice is a legal Topic Name (1..65535 bytes, no '+'/'#'), otherwise 0
CALL_CONTRACTS.FAILURE: never fails; used for will topic names inside CONNECT and for PUBLISH topic names

CALL_CONTRACTS.NAME: topic_filter_validate
CALL_CONTRACTS.RETURN: 1 when every byte of a SUBSCRIBE filter is validated as a legal Topic Filter, otherwise 0
CALL_CONTRACTS.FAILURE: never fails; a 0 result makes the whole SUBSCRIBE packet WIRE_INVALID

CALL_CONTRACTS.NAME: buffer_reserve
CALL_CONTRACTS.RETURN: 0 when capacity covers len+extra, -1 on overflow or allocation failure; on failure buf is unchanged
CALL_CONTRACTS.OWNERSHIP: may own a new allocation on success
CALL_CONTRACTS.FAILURE: returns -1, encoders map it to -2 and leave the output buffer unchanged

CALL_CONTRACTS.NAME: buffer_append
CALL_CONTRACTS.SIGNATURE: int buffer_append(struct byte_buf *buf, const void *src, size_t len)
CALL_CONTRACTS.RETURN: 0 when len bytes were copied, -1 on allocation failure; contents unchanged on failure
CALL_CONTRACTS.FAILURE: returns -1; encoders only append after a successful single reserve for the whole packet, so no partial packet can be left behind

CALL_CONTRACTS.NAME: buffer_tail
CALL_CONTRACTS.RETURN: Borrowed write pointer at data+len with *avail set to cap-len; used by wire_write_remaining_length
